views.name: financial_sales
views.definition:
SELECT so.id AS suborder_id,
    so.order_id,
    so.vendor_id,
    o.ticket_number,
    so.status,
    so.subtotal AS gross,
    so.commission_rate_snapshot AS commission_rate,
    so.commission_amount AS commission,
    so.subtotal - so.commission_amount AS vendor_earnings,
    o.total AS order_total,
    COALESCE(so.vendor_name_snapshot, v.name) AS vendor_name,
    (COALESCE(so.paid_at, o.created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg'::text)::date AS financial_date,
        CASE
            WHEN so.paid_at IS NULL THEN 'legacy_order_creation_date'::text
            ELSE 'paid_date'::text
        END AS date_basis,
    COALESCE(f.fee, 0::numeric) AS order_fee
   FROM order_suborders so
     JOIN orders o ON o.id = so.order_id
     JOIN vendors v ON v.id = so.vendor_id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payfast_itn_log.order_id,
            sum(payfast_itn_log.processor_fee) AS fee
           FROM payfast_itn_log
          WHERE payfast_itn_log.payment_status = 'COMPLETE'::text
          GROUP BY payfast_itn_log.order_id) f ON f.order_id = o.id
  WHERE NOT o.is_test AND so.payment_status = 'paid'::payment_status AND (so.status = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed'::order_status, 'accepted'::order_status, 'preparing'::order_status, 'ready'::order_status, 'collected'::order_status, 'completed'::order_status])) AND (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed'::order_status, 'accepted'::order_status, 'preparing'::order_status, 'ready'::order_status, 'collected'::order_status, 'completed'::order_status]));

functions.name: current_vendor_id
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_vendor_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT p.vendor_id FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.vendors v ON v.id=p.vendor_id
 WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.role='vendor' AND private.active_account()
 AND v.owner_id=p.id AND v.status<>'suspended' AND v.archived_at IS NULL;
$function$

functions.name: enforce_order_status_transition
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_order_status_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ declare old_step integer; new_step integer; begin if new.status=old.status then return new; end if; if old.status='cancelled'::public.order_status then raise exception 'Cannot change status of a cancelled order'; end if; if old.status in ('pending_payment'::public.order_status,'payment_submitted'::public.order_status) and new.status='confirmed'::public.order_status then return new; end if; select step into old_step from public.order_flow where status=old.status; select step into new_step from public.order_flow where status=new.status; if old_step is null or new_step is null or new_step<>old_step+1 then raise exception 'Invalid status transition: % -> %',old.status,new.status; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: guard_paid_item_history
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.guard_paid_item_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_suborders WHERE id=OLD.suborder_id AND payment_status='paid') AND
 (NEW.suborder_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.suborder_id OR NEW.meal_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.meal_name OR NEW.qty IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.qty OR NEW.price IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.price OR NEW.category_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.category_snapshot)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Paid order item history is immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: order_to_json
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.order_to_json(o orders)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', o.id,
    'ticket_number', o.ticket_number,
    'customer_id', o.customer_id,
    'guest_name', o.guest_name,
    'guest_contact', o.guest_contact,
    'guest_email', o.guest_email,
    'delivery_date', o.delivery_date,
    'delivery_location', o.delivery_location,
    'status', o.status,
    'total', o.total,
    'payment_proof_url', o.payment_proof_url,
    'payment_method', o.payment_method,
    'created_at', o.created_at,
    'profiles', case when o.customer_id is not null then
      (select jsonb_build_object('name', p.name) from profiles p where p.id = o.customer_id)
      else null end,
    'order_suborders', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', so.id,
        'vendor_id', so.vendor_id,
        'vendors', jsonb_build_object('name', v.name),
        'status', so.status,
        'payment_status', so.payment_status,
        'subtotal', so.subtotal,
        'collection_time', so.collection_time,
        'notes', so.notes,
        'order_items', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'meal_id', oi.meal_id,
            'meal_name', oi.meal_name,
            'qty', oi.qty,
            'price', oi.price
          ) order by oi.id)
          from order_items oi
          where oi.suborder_id = so.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
      ) order by so.id)
      from order_suborders so
      join vendors v on v.id = so.vendor_id
      where so.order_id = o.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_auth_identity_on_profile_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth.users WHERE id=NEW.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Profile requires Auth identity'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.snapshot_order_item()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN SELECT category INTO NEW.category_snapshot FROM public.meals WHERE id=NEW.meal_id; RETURN NEW; END $function$
